question: What is the maximum total current allowed in a ring circuit as per IEE regulations?
solution:
The correct answer is __30 amps__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ring circuit__ is a wiring method commonly used in the UK.
 
• The maximum total current allowed in a ring circuit is 30 amps as per IEE regulations.
 
• Ring circuits are used to distribute electricity efficiently in residential and commercial buildings.
 
• They are designed to handle higher loads compared to radial circuits.
 
• Proper installation and adherence to regulations are important for safety and performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fuse Ratings:**

 
 
• Fuses are used in circuits to protect against overcurrent.
 
• The fuse rating must match the maximum current capacity of the circuit.
 
 
 
• **IEE Regulations:**
 
 
• IEE regulations provide standards for electrical installations to ensure safety.
 
• Compliance with these regulations is mandatory in the UK.
 
 
 
• **Electrical Load:**
 
 
• The electrical load in a circuit should not exceed its maximum capacity to prevent overheating.
 
• Regular checks and maintenance are essential for circuit safety.
